entities.name: Battle of Kjeldor
entities.description: Battle at the start of the Thaw between Haakon's undead hordes and the defenders of Kjeldor.

entities.name: Thaw
entities.description: The era in which glaciers of Terisiare melt and the Ice Age loses its hold.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: Stromgald general of the undead hordes, defeated by King Darien.

entities.name: King Darien
entities.description: King of Kjeldor who joined the fight on the last day.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: A nation defended in the battle.

entities.name: Kjeld
entities.description: City of Kjeldor defended in the battle.

entities.name: Cult of Rimewind
entities.description: Heidar's cult, with zombies, orcs and Stromgald knights.

entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: Rimewind Cult leader who arrives with Phyrexian war machines.

entities.name: Garza Zol
entities.description: Vampire queen and Heidar's former co-conspirator.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Home of the elves who aided Kjeldor.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent with glaciers melted by the Thaw.

events.summary: An unnamed commander's soldiers and Jötun defend Kjeld against Heidar's hordes over four days.
events.quote: The battle lasted four days, and losses increased each day.

events.summary: King Darien joins the fight on the last day and defeats Haakon, ending the battle.
events.quote: On the last day, King Darien joined the fight and defeated Haakon

events.summary: Heidar arrives with Phyrexian war machines reclaimed from the melting ice.
events.quote: Heidar , the Rimewind Cult leader, shows up armed with Phyrexian war machines reclaimed from the melting ice.

events.summary: Yavimayan elves melt the frozen Phyrexian beasts with nature magic, causing them to collapse.
events.quote: used their nature magic to melt the frozen Phyrexian beasts, causing them to collapse

events.summary: Heidar attacks allies and enemies alike, giving Garza Zol reason to have him assassinated, then retreats to Krov.
events.quote: In desperation, Heidar started attacking both enemies and allies

events.summary: Kjeldor survives and a bond is forged between Yavimaya and New Argive.
events.quote: a bond was forged between Yavimaya and New Argive

relations.note: Sent spies and assassins against him.
relations.quote: the vampire queen had sent spies and assassins against her former co-conspirator
King Darien joined the fight and defeated Haakon
With the help of the Yavimayan elves, Kjeldor survived the battle
